description: Round 5 candidate mix11 (configs/recipes_v1.json): A3's stage 2 fine-tuning (from the frozen S3 checkpoint of the same seed; the ORIGINAL teacher labels of the 100 chapters, build 20261004-teacher100 setting T) with a replay of weak windows: every epoch trains on all teacher windows of the 100 chapters plus 1 x as many weak S3 windows of build 20261003-weak_v2, sampled without replacement with the run's seed from the other 649 training chapters (the teacher chapters are excluded from the pool), shuffled together, so what the 749-chapter stage learned is not overwritten while the teacher conventions are learned; every window keeps its own allowed label sets (partial-label NLL over both sources). Trainer: `python -m novel_ner.finetune train <this config> --setting T --seed N --run-id <id>`; tagger.train would ignore the replay block and re-run A3, so it must not be used with this config. Steps per epoch = ceil((1 + 1) x 500 teacher windows / 16) = 63, so 2520 planned steps over 40 epochs (A3: 32 per epoch, 1280 planned); eval every 2 epochs, patience 6, lr 3e-5, batch 16 and everything else as A3. config.json keeps the teacher build as the primary weak_labels record (the run scores as a model trained on the 100 teacher chapters) and records the replay under 'replay' (build, file sha256, pool size, sampled per epoch); metrics.json records the windows per epoch by source and each epoch's draw. Three seeds. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test. --- A3, which this candidate changes only by the replay: Stage 1 arm A3: the base backbone first trained on the 749 training chapters' weak S3 labels (the existing, frozen S3 checkpoints runs/20261003-tag-S3-s<seed>-dev31, one per seed) and then fine-tuned on the 100 teacher chapters' Opus labels (setting T of weak build 20261004-teacher100), NEEDLE's two-stage recipe. init_from_run names the checkpoint to start from; '{seed}' is replaced by the run's seed, so seed 1 starts from the S3 seed-1 run, seed 2 from seed 2, and so on (the pairing is recorded in config.json as init_from, with that run's config.json sha256). The run refuses a checkpoint from another backbone id. Everything else (schedule, lr, batch, sufficiency record, checkpoint rule) is train_s1_base: about 1300 planned steps, dev every 2 epochs, patience 6; the sufficiency record shows whether fine-tuning from a trained model needed fewer steps. Intended setting: T only (A3 compares with A2 = T from the fresh backbone: does the weak pre-training still help once teacher labels exist?); W from an S3 checkpoint would re-train on the same label source and is not an arm. Three seeds. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test.

arms.T: mix11 (A3 plus a 1:1 replay of weak S3 windows from the other 649 training chapters)

replay.rule: every epoch: all teacher windows (the 100 chapters, setting T of 20261004-teacher100) plus ratio x as many weak S3 windows of 20261003-weak_v2, sampled without replacement by random.Random(seed) from the 649 training chapters that are not teacher chapters, shuffled together; each window keeps its own allowed label sets (partial-label NLL over both sources); steps per epoch = ceil((1 + ratio) x teacher windows / batch_size); warmup, linear decay, eval cadence, patience, checkpoint rule and sufficiency record as tagger.fit (novel_ner.finetune)

init_from_run_note: '{seed}' is filled with --seed; the named run must be finished (metrics.json, checkpoints/best) and use the same backbone id

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo

planned_steps_note: ceil((1 + 1) x 500 teacher windows / 16) = 63 steps per epoch x 40 epochs = 2520 planned steps (A3: 32 x 40 = 1280); eval every 2 epochs = 126 steps; patience 6 evaluations = 12 epochs
